Harsh Kapoor | harsh.kapoor789@example.com | +91 9319799587
Whitefield, Bangalore

Professional Summary
Backend-focused developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable Node.js services, GraphQL APIs, and server-side systems using TypeScript and NestJS. Strong familiarity with AWS services, relational databases, and caching for high-throughput applications. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Node JS, TS, Express.js, S3, SQS, RDS, GraphQL, Redis, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Jira, Linux, Git

Work Experience

Node.js Developer, CartNest (Apr 2026 - Present)
- Implemented GraphQL resolvers and schema extensions using NestJS and TypeScript to support a unified product and cart API, reducing client roundtrips by 35% while maintaining Node.js service stability.
- Built background processing workers with Node.js and SQS for order fulfillment workflows; integrated S3 for persistent payload storage and used Redis for job coordination.
- Optimized PostgreSQL queries and introduced caching with Redis, improving API median latency by 40% under peak load.
- Managed deployments and release coordination via Git and Jira on Linux-based CI runners.

Backend Engineer, Pixelwave Studios (Feb 2026 - Mar 2026)
- Developed GraphQL endpoints and Node.js microservices to expose game metadata and user entitlements, leveraging AWS S3 for asset hosting and RDS for relational storage.
- Integrated Redis for session caching and transient leaderboards, reducing database read pressure by 25%.
- Collaborated through Git and Jira to ship a scoped backend MVP in an accelerated two-week cycle.

Backend Engineer, Helio Energy (Oct 2024 - Jan 2026)
- Built and maintained TypeScript-based Node.js services with NestJS to ingest telemetry and billing events into PostgreSQL, implementing batching and SQS-driven processing to improve throughput.
- Implemented GraphQL endpoints for internal dashboards and customer-facing queries; used Redis to cache frequent lookups and lower response times.
- Automated backups and retention for RDS snapshots and object lifecycle policies for S3; operated services on Linux hosts and coordinated tasks through Git and Jira.

Education
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
